promptPrefix:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: isolated combat VFX sprite for Slay the Spire board game.
Input images: image 1 is the existing effect to redesign; the remaining images are the actual character and enemy art, STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, never copy their bodies into the effect.
Primary request: repaint image 1 in exactly the reference artwork style: bold organic silhouette, hand-painted gouache-like color planes, soft brush texture, simplified cel shading, restrained highlights and dark painted edges. The effect must look illustrated by the same artist as those characters and enemies. Replace the glossy neon, fine filament fireworks, rainbow laser appearance with readable chunky brush-painted forms. Retain the existing subject, meaning, dominant hue, direction, relative placement and general silhouette. Keep effects expressive, readable at 60px. Use layered translucent painted edges, but no luminous photographic bloom or digital lens flare.
Scene/backdrop: true transparent RGBA background including translucent wisps; no scenery, floor, checkerboard pattern, drop shadow, frame or text. One standalone sprite, complete and unclipped with clear transparent padding.
Constraints: no characters, hands or faces from the style references; no labels, interface, numbers, new props or extra symbols.

meteorGeometry.measurement: Alpha-weighted PCA of runtime sprite; nose is mean of alpha >=204 pixels within two source pixels of maximum projection along the axis.
